query: Please implement a backend management system for managing and maintaining data. The system should have functionalities for data management, user management, permission management, and log management. Users should be able to log in, browse, add, edit, and delete data, manage users and permissions, and view log records. Style the layout with pale goldenrod in the background and dark olive green for the interface.
